annotations.text: wireframes — one desktop (1440) and one mobile (390) artboard per Phase 0 page type, in buyer-journey order. Round 2 (TASK-059, 2026-09-09): every page reworked against docs/design/benchmarks/. Spec 008 added the six listing and hub artboards; spec 009's round rebuilds product-desktop and product-mobile around the three date-picker states — unavailable, preview and live — and takes the countdown, the relative “today” chip, the Continue button, the add-on checkboxes, the withdrawal notice and the photo-on-delivery promise out of them. benchmarks/README.md records what each page type took and dropped, and the questions left for the founder.

Spec 009's design round: the three data-driven picker states (unavailable everywhere today, preview for the 16 October demo, live from Phase 1), the fee on every date chip before it is chosen, the absolute cutoff in the recipient's own zone, the holiday and occasion markers, no-photo as the common case, stale FX, the single-tier selector, the sticky mobile summary, and the honest sentence where a CTA would be.
